name: Swag — Athletic Directors (Spirit Stores)
e1:
SUBJ: {{school_name}} store page
BODY: Hi {{first_name}}, I mocked up a spirit-wear page for {{school_name}}. Every team on one link. Your mark on the hoodies and tees. A parent orders on a Tuesday, we print the piece, and it ships to their house. Nobody in the athletic office counts inventory or sits on a pile of leftovers. We're a 27-year, multi-million-dollar family business. The page is the whole first step. Not a catalog. Not a pitch deck. Want the {{school_name}} link? Ryan
